note: On the Elbow River in Kananaskis Country, 20 km west of Bragg Creek on Hwy 66; the highway west of Elbow Falls is closed from December 1 to May 14, and the campground map marks the winter gate on the Bragg Creek side of the entrance. Large, well-treed sites; the walk-in tent sites are along the river. Run for Alberta Parks by Kananaskis Campground Services; firewood is sold at the manager's site. --Claude

WEBSITE: the operator's page for this campground is https://www.kananaskiscampgrounds.com/valleys/elbow-valley (the stored second line is the site root).

WINTER GATE: Elbow Falls PRA page: 'Highway 66 (west of Elbow Falls) and Powderface Road are closed annually from December 1 to May 14.' The Beaver Flats campground map (updated August 2026) draws the 'Winter Gate' symbol on Hwy 66 north-east of the campground entrance, on the Bragg Creek side, so the campground lies beyond (west of) the gate; its posted season, May 15 - Sep 12, sits inside the open-road period.

On Esri imagery the pads of 42-46 are about 20-40 m from the river channel with a belt of trees between (imagery estimate); the other loops are farther back in forest.
